clauses.clause: {R}: This creature gains flying until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: the ability is never activatable in the trace ('not activatable from battlefield: condition:false'), so neither its {R} cost, the grant to itself, nor its duration is shown. Tree = the compiler's B3-grant-kw-self parse. Packs: D08_1 (legal with my flier; only the Goblin gains flying; {R} spent; unblockable by ground), D08_3 (the {R} cost), D08_4 (flying ends with the turn).

clauses.clause: Activate only if you control a creature with flying.
clauses.evidence: only the closed gate is shown: 'not activatable: condition:false' with the opponent's flier on the board and none of mine; the open gate is never shown. Tree = the compiler's B5a-activate-only-flying parse folded into the ability's condition. Packs: D08_1 (my flier opens it), D08_2 (only the opponent's flier, or my reach and non-flying creatures: refused; my flier enters: legal).
